description:
Simulator.Company behaviour simulation specialist ("what if" on a graph). Use when the user wants to simulate, forecast or compare scenarios on a layer: describe how actors behave, change parameters (price, capacity, delivery time, growth, AI share), play model time forward and compare metrics. Any graph works — a company, a process, infrastructure, a supply chain — and accounts can hold any quantity (money, items, hours, slots).
Trigger on any of these intents: — "what if", "simulate", "forecast", "scenario", "compare scenarios", "how many will
  we finish", "where is the bottleneck", "what will it cost in 3 months".
— "симуляция", "смоделируй", "прогони симуляцию", "что будет если", "прогноз",
  "сравни сценарии", "проверь модель", "симуляція", "змоделюй", "що буде якщо".
— the user points at a behaviour model (`model.yaml`, `scenarios.yaml`) or a layer YAML
  file and asks to run or check it. Use these tools for that, not other simulation CLIs.
Tools: simulationCheck, simulationRun, simulationSnapshot (read-only; nothing is written to Simulator).
